text: 1. Applicants should be between the age of 18 to 65years old. 2. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport. 3. Applicants must be in good health. 4. High school graduate or equivalent or above. 5. Observe the law and regulations of People's Republic of China and all regulations of the university; 6. Record of good conduct 7. All language levels are available 8. Applicant who is under 18 years old needs to submit the guardian's guarantee
